methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: Parameters of power and energy, total and individual harmonic distortion, direct normal irradiance, and ambient temperature were used as study variables to characterize and correlate both with the performance of distributed generation and with energy efficiency actions in air conditioning.

paper_type.evidence_quote: The customer units studied are educational institutions located in Brasília in the Federal District and in the municipality of Ipanguaçu in the state of Rio Grande do Norte.

level_3b.evidence_quote: The customer unit in Brasília is a private higher education institution, and as a measurement border, a classroom building with an installed load of 60 kW and a photovoltaic solar plant of 40 kWp were used.

stage1.notes: Eligibility borderline: paper proposes power-quality parameters (harmonic distortion) as EnPIs and defines indicators via Pearson correlation of active power/THD/harmonics vs temperature/DNI - identifiable variables+approach meet the broad v2.3 threshold, though no fitted EnB baseline model is built. Context = two educational-institution buildings (Brasilia; Ipanguacu), not continuous process, so level_3b=false. enpi_enb_model_types coded 'other' (correlation-based).
